agent.finish_summary: Fixed inverted condition in IndexedSet._get_real_index (boltons/setutils.py) that caused index lookups to skip translation through dead/tombstoned slots after removals, leading to KeyError: _MISSING and broken __getitem__/pop/index behavior. Changed `if self.dead_indices: return index` to `if not self.dead_indices: return index`. Verified via manual script: removals creating dead indices, then __getitem__ (positive/negative), index(), pop(), and out-of-bounds IndexError all work correctly.
